top_signals.title: Fed’s Collins Says Interest Rates Are Still Mildly Restrictive
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston President Susan Collins said there’s still evidence the central bank’s current policy setting is restraining the US economy and helping to slow inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Anthropic pushes into physical world with new standard to help AI agents operate machines
top_signals.summary: The Model Hardware Standard is initially available in a research preview, but Anthropic plans to open source it in the future.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Nvidia jumps 9% after blockbuster earnings boost AI confidence
top_signals.summary: Nvidia shares rose on Thursday after the chip giant's revenue guidance reassured investors that AI demand will remain strong.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: BlackRock’s Mitchnick says bitcoin’s risk-off narrative is ‘the one to bet on’ long term as rally consolidates near $80,000
top_signals.summary: Renewed spot ETF inflows and bitcoin's declining correlation with equities are also constructive signs, according to analysts.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Okta's stock skyrockets 27%, CrowdStrike's surges 18% as rising AI threat boosts earnings
top_signals.summary: AI adoption is pushing customers to spend more on cybersecurity tools from companies such as CrowdStrike and Okta
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

Meta settlement opens new front in global fight over social media harm
top_signals.summary: Meta's up to $18 billion settlement with nearly all U.S. states over social media harm to teenagers has opened a new front in a global government fight to protect children.
